title: State of Sec Morocco 2026: aggregated results
description: The shares printed in the State of Sec Morocco 2026 White Paper (edition 1), in a machine-readable form. Aggregates only: no row-level data, no free text.
attribution: State of Sec Morocco 2026, by Salah-Eddine El Ouali and Abdelkarim Mouchquelita (stateofsec.ma, doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24337485). Inspired by stateofdev.ma and the GeeksBlaBla community.

sample.kind: Open, anonymous community survey. Self-selected sample, not weighted: the shares describe the people who answered, not all of Morocco's security workforce.

reading_notes: Shares are percentages with at most one decimal, as printed in the White Paper. Each share is computed among the people described in the question's base.
Questions with "multiple": true allowed several answers: their shares do not add up to 100.
An option marked "routed": true was shown to some respondents only (see optionShowIf in questions.json): its share is computed among those who saw it.
"small_base": true means few people were asked: read the shares as directions.

When options_published is lower than options_in_survey, the White Paper does not print the remaining options ("Other", the least chosen ones, or options shown to fewer than 10 people; for gender, it prints the share of women only). Free text is never published.
"combined" gives shares the White Paper quotes for several options together. They are computed before rounding, so they can differ by 0.1 from the sum of the parts.
Counts are not published, except the few small-group figures the White Paper itself prints (in "breakdowns").

students_with_a_certificate.statement: Among students, 37% already hold at least one certificate.

three_years_or_more_in_security.statement: 56% of employees of foreign organizations have three years or more in security, against 33% of employees of Moroccan organizations. In the two pay charts: 57% of the USD salary group (a small group of 30), against 42% of the MAD income group.

active_bug_bounty_hunters_who_earned_not.statement: Among active hunters only (those who take part regularly or now and then), 24 of 73 earned nothing in the last 12 months.

plans_to_work_abroad_by_job_satisfaction.statement: Among respondents with a job who are satisfied with it, 18 of 55 plan to work outside Morocco within 24 months; among the unsatisfied, 15 of 28. Small bases.

amazigh_in_souss_massa.statement: 14 of the 30 respondents in Souss-Massa who answered read or write Amazigh.

eu_rules_among_those_based_in_morocco.statement: Among those asked question community-q-1 who are based in Morocco, 20% have worked under GDPR, NIS2 or DORA, directly or through clients.

time_to_first_job_of_graduates.statement: Leaving out those who have not graduated yet, 33.7% started working straight away and 27.6% within three months. 10.2% waited more than a year.

sentiment_index.name: Moroccan Cyber Sentiment Index
sentiment_index.method: Three questions, three pillars, equal weights. Each answer gets a score between 0 and 1; a pillar is the average score times 100; the index is the average of the pillars.

pillars.question: work-q-16
pillars.scoring: yes in 12 months = 0, yes in 24 months = 0, still hesitating = 0.5, no = 1

pillars.question: work-q-8
pillars.scoring: very unsatisfied = 0 ... very satisfied = 1, in steps of 0.25

pillars.question: community-q-2
pillars.scoring: not at all = 0, poorly = 0.25, adequately = 0.6, well = 1, don't know = 0.4

sentiment_index.limits: Each pillar has its own base: people in Morocco, people with a job, everyone. Scoring and weights are frozen for 2027. No margin of error.
